title: SearchResult
description: A search result representing a package, with metadata from the latest version.

id.description: The ID of the matched package.

version.description: The full SemVer 2.0.0 version string of the latest package version.

versions.description: All versions of the package matching the prerelease parameter.

authors.description: The author or authors of the package.

iconUrl.description: The URL to the package icon.

licenseUrl.description: The URL to the package license.

owners.description: The owner or owners of the package on the package source.

projectUrl.description: The URL to the project page.

registration.description: The absolute URL to the associated registration index.

totalDownloads.description: The total number of downloads across all versions.

verified.description: Whether the package is verified via ID prefix reservation.

packageTypes.description: The package types defined by the package author.
